claim: Upstream pins the iso_week::weekday representation with compile-time constants: weekday{0u}.ok() is false while weekday{1u} through weekday{7u} are all ok(), and both converting directions are asserted to exist, is_convertible<date::weekday, iso_week::weekday> and is_convertible<iso_week::weekday, date::weekday>; this is the upstream test that makes 0 an invalid ISO weekday and therefore the reason the 0/7 re-encoding cannot be dropped.
